name: autoresearch-baseline decide(needs_clarification) → coordinator (inherit anchor)
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign autoresearch pack recovery rule — BASELINE branch (ADR-053 Phase 4b-1a anchor split). Fires when autoresearch-baseline terminates with decide(action=needs_clarification) — parameter parse failed / sandbox unreachable / baseline command crashed. Spawns a fresh coordinator (allow-list respond_direct / ask_user) to deliver the situation to the user.

WHY split from the other autoresearch roles (the §E anchor asymmetry, mirrors run-failed rules 12/13): baseline is spawned by rule 01 with run_scope=new, so it carries a bare agent.run triple (graph_writer.go:535-539) — the coordinator this rule spawns therefore INHERITS agent.run.entity-id down the loop-spawn chain (actions.go default-inherit copies the firing loop's bare agent.run into the child RunID). So if that woken coordinator fails involuntarily while the run is executing, agent-run/05 (the agent.run.entity-id branch) drives executing→failed — anchor_inherit, no threading needed. The run-entity-descended roles (propose/execute/synthesize/reviewer) carry NO bare agent.run (spawned by the run-entity-fired rules 03/05/07), so their coordinator inherits nothing and must thread the anchor explicitly — sibling rule 10b.

Mirrors research pack's 06-needs-clarification-replan.json (also anchor_inherit), scoped to autoresearch-baseline.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
An autoresearch role at loop $entity.instance terminated with decide(action=needs_clarification). The role's reason field describes the framing or environment gap that blocked it.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result(loop_id=$entity.instance) to read the rejecting role's reason + retry_hint.

Iteration 2 — your job is to deliver the situation to the user — either as a question (ask_user) when the gap is something the user can fix in one round-trip, or as a status (respond_direct) when the gap is structural and the user should see the partial-progress story. Examples:

- Baseline rejected because metric_parser could not extract a number from stdout → ask_user with a specific question about the expected output format.
- Propose rejected because the surface is too narrow and the journal shows plateau → respond_direct explaining the run reached its natural stopping point under the current surface; suggest a wider surface for a follow-up run.
- Execute rejected because the sandbox was unreachable → respond_direct describing the environment failure; this is not a question for the user, it's an operator-side issue.

Call decide(action="respond_direct", reason="<status prose>") OR decide(action="ask_user", reason="<question prose>"). Both are published on the user-response bus.

metadata.phase: ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign — second pack; ADR-053 Phase 4b-1a anchor split
metadata.anchor_disposition: anchor_inherit (TestAgentRunPack_CoordinatorSpawnCoverage) — baseline carries a bare agent.run (rule 01 run_scope=new), so the spawned coordinator inherits agent.run.entity-id and a failure routes to agent-run/05. NO run-loop-entity-id thread.
metadata.split_rationale: Sibling of rule 10b (propose/execute/synthesize/reviewer). The two are split on the firing role's anchor: baseline carries agent.run.entity-id (inherit → rule 05); the descended roles carry only agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id (thread → rule 06). Same baseline-vs-descended asymmetry as run-failed rules 12 vs 13 and the success path (autoresearch/08).
metadata.anchor_guard: agent.run.entity-id != "" documents + enforces the inherit dependency (a run-less baseline cannot exist — rule 01 run_scope=new always mints — but the guard makes the anchor_inherit contract explicit).
metadata.max_iterations_note: Per-entity caveat applies (research pack's 05 metadata explains in detail). Practical effect under the current rule engine: bound is informational; each needs_clarification is a fresh entity.
metadata.mirrors_research_pattern: Same shape as configs/rules/research/06-needs-clarification-replan.json (also anchor_inherit), scoped to autoresearch-baseline.
